svg.title: Shelton Compact Vertical - black
svg.desc: Narrow panels, garment fronts, banners. Selected Shelton logo system in solid black.
svg.metadata: Selected Shelton review identity. Canonical circled-S path unchanged. Sharp Grotesk Medium 25 lettering converted to outlines with tracking -26. Barless capital I option 02 uses the native Sharp stem and a symmetrically tightened advance. Inter Medium ampersand option 04 is enlarged approximately 8 percent. No live text.
